persona: graphic designer judging composition and typography

designs.why: Reads instantly at 3 m: a heavy rounded lowercase 'the / end' with tight leading, 'end' truly sitting on the horizon, and the half sun as a strong counterweight just after the word. The sun-glitter column leads the eye down and to the boat, and the line spacing opens up toward the bottom for depth. Gulls and boat balance the type nicely. Weaknesses: the top water lines are very tight and may clog or moire on a tee, the boat crowds the right edge, and a stray dark dash at the right margin (about 1380,1150 in the small view) looks like a glitch.
designs.fix: Remove the stray dash at right (about y=1150) and pull the boat and right-edge lines in a little from the margin, while opening up the line spacing just under the horizon so it will not fill in at print.
